=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:254-256 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git_remote_op` pattern `\bgit\s+(fetch|pull|clone|push|remote|ls-remote)\b` matches the prose phrase "no git remote", which this same PR added to the judge prompt's "Implementer environment" paragraph (prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt line 24 and its _templates copy). minimax adds that the `origin_ref` pattern (line 256) has the same problem with prose such as "do not diff against origin/main". As a result, a sandbox-safe verdict that repeats the prompt's wording is refused as sandbox_incompatible:git_remote_op.
  WHY: The re-ask note at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1589 ("Rewrite them using only the Implementer environment above") sends the model back to the same wording, so the second answer is likely to fail too. That ends in refused_after_reask, then the `invalid_verdict` wait marker (lines 1595-1600), with no round consumed. Each later scan then pays for two model calls plus a public comment and the item stays blocked. tests/test_unblock_judge.py only covers command-shaped text. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 and gpt-6-luna rated NIT; gemini, minimax and qwen rated MAJOR. The highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18607-18612 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In `_pr_json_implements_issue`, `_impl_repo` depends on GITHUB_REPOSITORY being set in `<owner>/<name>` form. When it is unset or malformed, matching falls back to the bare `#N` regex without the repository scope guard.
  WHY: Callers outside Actions could match `#N` references without the same-repository guard. Actions usually sets the variable. minimax rated this hardening-only rather than a defect.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan docs/plans/sandbox-aware-unblock-and-implements-marker-plan.md Phase 2 step 7 / Goal G4: "`CLAUDE.md` §19: after the 'blocker bug' bullet, add a bullet. A PR that implements an orchestrator **item** issue (labelled `ai:orchestrator-managed`, not `ai:orchestrator-tracking`) ... carries a line `Implements #N` so the poller links it. Bare `Refs #N` is not enough."
  expected_change_site: CLAUDE.md §19, immediately after the bullet beginning "A PR that fixes a **blocker bug** surfaced by an orchestrator project"
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: There is no CLAUDE.md hunk in the PR diff (pr_changed_files.txt lists 25 files, none of them CLAUDE.md), and §19 still has no `Implements #N` guidance. agents.d/7765-implements-marker.md records the bullet as a pending operator step (IMPLEMENTS_MARKER_CLAUDE_MD_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP) with the exact text, and changelog.d/7765-implements-marker.md says pipeline editors cannot write CLAUDE.md. The interactive commands were updated but CLAUDE.md was not. Severity disagreement: gemini rated MAJOR; sonnet, minimax and luna rated NIT. qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputes that this is a gap because the deferral is documented.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:SANDBOX_INCOMPATIBLE_PATTERNS ("git_remote_op", re.compile(r"\bgit\s+(fetch|pull|clone|push|remote|ls-remote)\b", re.IGNORECASE)) via _check_sandbox_instructions() in validate(..., sandbox_check=True); re-ask note in scripts/unblock_judge.sh UNBLOCK_JUDGE_REASK_NOTE | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The regex matches the phrase "no git remote" from the new "Implementer environment" paragraph in prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-judge-unblock.txt. The re-ask note invites the model to reuse that wording, and the refusal reports only the pattern id.
  WHY: A verdict that echoes the prompt is refused, and the re-ask likely fails the same way (refused_after_reask, then the invalid_verdict wait marker). No round is spent, so every later scan pays for two model calls. The tests only cover command-shaped text ("run git pull first", ROUND2_639).
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Phase 2 of docs/plans/sandbox-aware-unblock-and-implements-marker-plan.md lists CLAUDE.md. Interactive sessions should use "Implements #N" instead of a bare "Refs #N" for orchestrator items. | Expected change site: CLAUDE.md §19, directly after the "blocker bug" bullet | Evidence of absence: The PR does not change CLAUDE.md. agents.d/7765-implements-marker.md records it as IMPLEMENTS_MARKER_CLAUDE_MD_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP. The deferral is documented. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- HARDENING (risk score 2, 2 related items): in scripts/unblock_ledger.py, match `remote` only in command form and add a prose test. In scripts/unblock_judge.sh, add a fixed sentence to UNBLOCK_JUDGE_REASK_NOTE forbidding these terms even in prose.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

Neither prose form is tested.
  WHY: The re-ask note at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1589 points back at the paragraph that triggers the match. That leads to `refused_after_reask` (1583-1585), then the `invalid_verdict` marker (1595-1600) with no round consumed. The result is two model calls, an extra public comment, and the item still blocked. The PR's own prompt causes this, unlike the breadth the changelog documents.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Plan step 7 (Phase 2) requires a CLAUDE.md §19 bullet: items carry `Implements #N`, and bare `Refs #N` is not enough. CLAUDE.md is listed under Phase 2 "Files & Modules" (line 175). | Expected change site: CLAUDE.md §19, immediately after the "blocker bug" bullet | Evidence of absence: No CLAUDE.md hunk (pr_changed_files.txt lists 25 files, none CLAUDE.md). The /investigate-issue and /validate-consumer-issue sessions are left without the convention. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
- HARDENING (aggregate risk score 3, 2 related items): extend UNBLOCK_JUDGE_REASK_NOTE at scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 1589 with a fixed per-id hint (risk 2). In scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 18607-18611, fail closed when `_impl_repo` is empty: log `reason=repository_unknown`, `return 2` (risk 3).
- NOTE: Verified as sound: the close-sweep `_pr_json_base_is_target_merge` gate (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5216), the fail-closed path in scripts/orchestrate_stall_retired_conflict.sh:107, plan.yml env placement and ordering, re-ask loop termination, and the reask-note sanitisation (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1582).
